name: wagering-processor
description: Processador distribuido de apostas - Bun + NestJS + TypeORM + PostgreSQL + SQS (LocalStack)

scripts.bootstrap: bun run infra:up && bash scripts/wait-for-infra.sh && bun run migration:run
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: WORKERS_ENABLED=false LOG_LEVEL=error PENDING_REFERENCE_BASE_DELAY_MS=1 PENDING_REFERENCE_MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 bun test test/integration
